description: Full record for one contractor license by number: status, license types, bond, insurance, workers' comp, discipline, complaints and citations where published, city permits, and the agency source link. California is the default; pass state for others. Use this when you have a license number, or after search_licenses to read a match in full (use the id it returns).

license_number.description: License number as the agency prints it, or the id from search_licenses, e.g. "1154967" (CA) or "CGC047089" (FL).

state.description: Two-letter state code. Default CA. License records: CO, CT, FL, IL, KS, MN, NY, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA. City permit records only (record_type permits_only, no state license data): AZ, GA, HI, LA, MA, MI, NC, NV, OH, TN.

name: get_license

outputSchema.description: One license record, or found: false with a note. California records carry checks (license, bond, workers' comp) and alerts; other states carry status_class, actions and verify_url.

alerts.description: Plain sentences for anything that is not ok.

checks.description: California: one reading each of the license, bond and workers' comp, with a quotable detail sentence.

data_as_of.description: Date the data was copied from the agency, YYYY-MM-DD.

found.description: False when the license is not in this dataset. That does not mean the contractor is unlicensed.

note.description: Why nothing was found, when found is false.

record_type.description: license, or permits_only for businesses known only from city permits.

recourse.description: What to do if this contractor doesn't finish the job or pay its subs: summary (a sentence to quote), this license's bond and how to claim it, the agency to complain to, the state recovery fund if any, guide_url and checked_on. From official sources; not legal advice.

related_licenses.description: California: suspended licenses that share a person (officer, owner or qualifier, matched by CSLB's person ID) with this one, each with a quotable sentence, reason, date and CSLB link. No names.

status.description: Other states: the agency's own status.

status_class.description: Other states: active, inactive, expired, suspended, revoked or other.

verify_url.description: Other states: the agency's live lookup.

workers_comp_exempt_large_jobs.description: California: for a license exempt from workers' comp, city permits since 2021 that declared $100,000 or more, with a quotable sentence and caveat.

title: Get a contractor license record
